summary: This undated record registers the gift made by Malladeva alias (?) Banarasa to a certain -¦ Eraya

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 2
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up In A Field Behind The Ruined Village, Budidealle, Punganur Zamindari, Same District
summary: This is not dated and refers itself to the reign of Mahavali-Banaraja Vikramaditya-Jayameru and states that during the cattle-raid at Kurunjeala by Mudhudara Gonamenthi of Minikki, Periyavan fell fighting

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 3
location_detail: On Another Slab Set Up In The Same Place
summary: This is not dated and refers itself to the reign of the Bana king Mavali-Vanarasa and mentions the same raid by Mudunda of Minki on Kurumjiyala during which the hero Alamaran alias Kelemuldan is stated to have fought and died

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 4
location_detail: On A Third Slab Set Up In The Same Place
summary: This is not dated and refers itself to the reign of the Bana king Mahavali Vanarasa

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 5 — Punganuru
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up Outside The Somesvara Temple At Punganuru, Same Zamindari And District
summary: This undated inscription records the gift of a wet land of a Kanduga os spwomg capacity, (to the family of ) Kalianiga Kandanarayana who died after slaying nine thieves when the Bana king Vijayaditya Prabhumeru was ruling over Vadugavali twelve-thousand province and east of Manne and Kaduvatti-Mutta

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 6 — Karshnapalle
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up In A Field At Karshnapalle, Same Samindari And District
date_text: Since the characters of the record are of the 9th century A.D. it may be assigned to the time of Vijayaditya II
summary: This is not dated and refers itself to the reign of the Bana king Banarasa, who was also in charge of the Ganga six-thousand province when Ballaha i.e., the Rashtrakuta king led a campaign against Kaduvetti, for not paying tribute

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 8 — Karshanapalle
location_detail: On A Slab Built Into The Nadi-Mandapa In The Arkesvara Temple At Karshanapalle, Same Zamindari And District
summary: It mentions Banarasa of the Mahavali kula ruling over [Ganga] six-thousand province

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 9 — Pudupatla
location_detail: On A Pillar Set Up In Front Of The Chaudesvari Temple At Pudupatla, Same Zamindari And District
summary: This undated record refers itself to the reign of the Bana king Banarasa and records that a certain person named Jayanagan walked into the sacred fire on the day of winter solstice and died and that this stone was set up by some person (name lost)

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 10 — Embadi
location_detail: On A Stone Set Up At Embadi, Same Zamindari And District
summary: It refers itself to the reign of the Bana king Mahavali-Banarasa and registers the grant of a plot of wet land, five kula in sowing capacity, (by the king?) to a certain [Ga]vunda on the occasion of a cattle-raid

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 11
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up In A Field In Front Of The Village Chadalla, On Punganur-Chdum Road, Same Zamindari And District
summary: This undated record refers itslef to the reign of the Bana king Mahaali-Banarasa

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 12 — Karshanapalle
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up In A Field At Karshanapalle, Same Zamindari And District
